translation_notes: prefixes: RDF->rdf, XSD->xsd, plus the ns_def_local local sd = Namespace("...") as a third @prefix.
sd is only ever used through attribute access (sd.Service, sd.endpoint, sd.resultFormat) to build terms, so no `as NAME` binding is needed.
The three isolated g.add(...) calls become one @graph g declaration plus one +{ } per add (add_isolated pattern), rather than g{ } literals merged with +=: same cardinality, no refactoring.
